_note: Affinity router tunables (design lane D6). All scoring weights live in this ONE ROUTING_WEIGHTS block — they are hypotheses, re-fit from shadow data per the eval plan, and never edited silently (weight changes are journaled as config records). Shadow mode is the safe default: the router computes and journals routing records but changes no routing decisions.

shadow.promotion: no automatic promotion — leaving shadow requires a recorded human decision per D6 §4.3
